name: Sync new/updated case from Microsoft Dynamics CRM to ServiceNow
description:
1. A case is created or updated in Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

2. Workato searches for a matching incident in ServiceNow by **case title**.

3. If no matching incident is found in ServiceNow, Workato creates a new incident.

4. If matching incident is found in ServiceNow, Workato updates that incident.
